No, a court will likely not enforce the bar against assigning the right to payment. This is a sale of goods, so UCC § 2-210(2) lets a right arising from the seller's due performance of its entire obligation be assigned despite a contrary agreement. UCC § 9-406(d) likewise overrides contract terms that prohibit assigning a right to payment, so the center must pay the assignee once the distributor has performed.

CONFIDENCE: 88
